visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a young man sitting still as a stylist uses a flat iron on his hair. He is wearing a black lace shirt with intricate patterns. The background is a dark green wall decorated with posters, including one prominently featuring the 'Taiwan Trans March' logo. (2) A sharp cut shows the man now in a full performance outfit: a black glossy leather-like jacket over the lace top, heavy dark eye makeup, and black high-thigh boots. He is in a white hallway or backstage area with industrial lighting. (3) He is seen performing on a nightclub stage with a checkered floor, surrounded by multiple disco balls and vibrant neon pink lighting. He holds a black microphone. (4) The scene shifts to a larger outdoor stage during the day. He is singing and dancing energetically in front of a large white banner that reads 'Taiwan Trans March' and 'Taiwan Transgender March'. (5) Back in the nightclub, he interacts with a cheering crowd that is filming him with their smartphones. The atmosphere is high-energy with colorful light beams. (6) On the large stage again, the camera zooms in as he sings with one hand raised, bathed in bright purple and blue stage lights. (7) A side profile shot on the large stage shows him continuing the performance amidst thick white stage smoke. (8) In the nightclub setting, he performs a synchronized arm-waving dance move, encouraging the audience to follow along. (9) He is seen from a distance on the large stage under intense red and blue spotlights, casting long shadows. (10) He raises a hand towards the disco balls in the nightclub while the crowd cheers and claps enthusiastically. (11) The performance concludes on the large stage as he waves to the audience and walks off into the red-lit background as the lights dim.
